basis: Observed product and engineering decisions recorded in the SelfGrow repository. Do not infer identity, private experience, or facts absent from this protocol.
purpose: Provide an advisory relevance score for newly captured Raw material. The score must never auto-select, reject, delete, or distill content.
preferences: Practical AI and agent-engineering projects, skills, workflows, and learning material that can be reused in real work
A single explicit SelfGrow Skill entry point for repository initialization, selected-Raw discovery, rule-based distillation, relationship linking, and approved structural or preference updates
Clear mechanisms, reproducible steps, source evidence, explicit limitations, and verifiable outcomes
Local-first and privacy-preserving tools with explicit approval, rollback, data ownership, and cross-device compatibility
Minimal interfaces and native platform capabilities instead of speculative infrastructure or decorative complexity
Material that adds a durable concept, method, implementation pattern, or meaningful comparison to the existing knowledge workflow
downrank: Marketing copy, hype, vague trend commentary, unverified claims, or content with little usable mechanism
Shallow lists, repeated summaries, licensing or author promotion, and material that adds no durable knowledge
Automatic recommendation, hidden automation, or invasive data collection presented without user control or evidence

rubric.0-39: Weak fit or low-signal material with little reusable value
rubric.40-59: Some relevance but limited evidence, novelty, or practical depth
rubric.60-79: Useful and aligned material worth reviewing
rubric.80-100: Strongly aligned, evidence-rich, reusable material with clear practical value
